role: Declarations of the Objective-C @try/@catch shims that let Swift call NSException-raising AVFoundation APIs (AVAudioEngine start/prepare/stop/reset, input-node tap install/remove, voice processing, AVSpeechSynthesizer speak/stop) and get NO + NSError instead of SIGABRT.
toplevel: NS_ASSUME_NONNULL region; nine BOOL-returning function prototypes with header comments documenting the beta crash reports that motivated each (lines 7-10, 27-40, 48-52, 56-67, 82-94). Only `format` in FRSafeInstallTap is nullable, so the nil-argument guards in SafeObjC.m are unreachable from Swift callers.
